rust_summary: a player's chat message before it is sent (`native_player_chat`).
doc_summary: A player's chat message is about to be sent to everyone: `native_player_chat(player, name, message, replies, cancel)` is heard once for each message a player sends, after the secure-chat chain and the chat filter took it and before anyone sees it. Set `cancel` to drop it for everybody; push lines to `replies` and they go to the sender as system chat (the sender is not told otherwise). The text cannot be changed, a signed message would no longer verify. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_chat@.
